chapter: Photographs, reading music and Wingy Manone
title: Peck Kelly rumor and working with Wingy Manone in San Antonio
summary: He knew Peck Kelly but never worked with him, and says he played in Texas with Wingy Manone.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So we'll have to get this article. That'll be good. Uh, did you ever know a fellow named Peck Kelly?
Yeah. I knew Peck Kelly when he was in Texas.
Yeah, I knew Peck. But I never worked with him.
No, no. I worked in Texas with Wingy Manone. San Antonio, Texas.
I wondered. I saw something about you being with Peck Kelly.
No, I never was with Peck Kelly. No, not me. No, uh-uh. I never was with Peck.
And that was Wingy's band in San Antonio?
Yeah, that was Wingy's band, yeah.
